description: This file contains functions for web page clipping, article extraction, screenshot generation, and DOM element interaction within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for clipping pages and articles, capturing screenshots, and managing element selection modes with visual cues.

methods.name: clipPage
methods.description: Clips the entire page content, returning HTML string with doctype.

methods.name: clipArticle
methods.description: Extracts the main article content from a document using Readability, returning HTML string.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes selection styles and event listeners from the document.

methods.name: clipScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the page or element in specified image format.

methods.name: enterNodeSelectionMode
methods.description: Enables element selection mode with visual cues and controls for clipping selected nodes.
